question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left winger, Bob is playing right back, Claire is playing benchwarmer, Dave is playing goalkeeper, Eve is playing left midfielder, Fred is playing cheerleader, and Gertrude is playing striker.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Bob and Fred trade positions. Then, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Alice trade positions. Then, Alice and Fred trade positions. Finally, Gertrude and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Fred is playing
Options:
(A) left winger
(B) right back
(C) benchwarmer
(D) goalkeeper
(E) left midfielder
(F) cheerleader
(G) striker
solution:
Player order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: left winger, right back, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, left midfielder, cheerleader, striker
After Eve–Gertrude: left winger, right back, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, striker, cheerleader, left midfielder
After Bob–Gertrude: left winger, left midfielder, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, striker, cheerleader, right back
After Bob–Fred: left winger, cheerleader, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, striker, left midfielder, right back
After Eve–Bob: left winger, striker, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, cheerleader, left midfielder, right back
After Gertrude–Alice: right back, striker, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, cheerleader, left midfielder, left winger
After Alice–Fred: left midfielder, striker, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, cheerleader, right back, left winger
After Gertrude–Eve: left midfielder, striker, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, left winger, right back, cheerleader
Fred's final position is right back, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
